name: User
promise: Synthetic user for finite observation checks.

name: Project
promise: Synthetic project for finite observation checks.

name: ExportJob
promise: Synthetic job for finite observation checks.

name: Role
definition: True exactly when the user has the export role for this project at this observation point.

name: Available
definition: True exactly when the export artifact for this job is available at this observation point. Confirmed absence means false.

name: Requested
definition: True exactly when the observed request decision allows this user to request an export for this project.

name: Delivered
definition: True exactly when the observed delivery decision allows this user to receive this job in this project.

rule: The observed request decision must equal the declared synthetic policy decision.
logic: FORALL u: C-DEMO-USER. FORALL p: C-DEMO-PROJECT. P-DEMO-REQUESTED(u, p) IFF P-DEMO-ROLE(u, p)

rule: The observed delivery decision must equal the declared synthetic policy decision.
logic: FORALL u: C-DEMO-USER. FORALL p: C-DEMO-PROJECT. FORALL j: C-DEMO-JOB. P-DEMO-DELIVERED(u, p, j) IFF (P-DEMO-ROLE(u, p) AND P-DEMO-AVAILABLE(j))
